note: Deliberate exceptions, per the quality-gate checklist: document them here, never by ignoring the report. Everything not listed below was fixed, not excused.

exceptions.scope: h1 > span.foil — the word PRESS. One element, page-wide.
exceptions.reason: Not decoration and not invented. The five stops (#00EAFF 0%, #0080FF 25.25%, #8000FF 49.74%, #E619E6 74.99%, #FF0000 99.91%) and the ~160deg axis are lifted verbatim from linearGradient-1 in https://bridge.pulsechain.com/logo.svg — the client's own chain identity, and the law-6 extraction source Schyler directed us to. A holographic foil gradient is also literally what the product is: a holo die-cut sticker. DESIGN-STANDARD 3.3 caps gradient-clipped text at 2 elements per page; we use 1.
exceptions.verified: Contrast of the clipped text is not measurable by the detector; the h1 is 46-116px at weight 800 and every stop exceeds 3:1 on #000 (worst stop #FF0000 = 4.25:1, above the 3:1 large-text threshold).

exceptions.reason: False positive. This is a data graphic, not a pictorial scene: a plate-carree dot-matrix world map rasterised from Natural Earth 110m land polygons (1,672 dots emitted as ONE path of round-capped zero-length segments) plus 10 sighting pins. The detector counts the pins as 'primitive shapes'. Its own guidance exempts data graphics. Halftone dots are also the section's design vocabulary — the map is printed, like everything else on the page.
exceptions.verified: Rendered and eyeballed at 390/834/1280; continents identifiable, pin positions computed from real lat/lon.

exceptions.scope: Short mono labels only: .sub, .kicker, .edge-text, .hallmark, .status, .accept .k, .accept .chain, .map-legend, .chip-stock, .wand-toggle. All 34-47 characters.
exceptions.reason: DESIGN-STANDARD 3.5 mandates letterspaced uppercase kickers as house grammar, and the rule's own text permits uppercase for 'short labels and headings'. The two genuine long-passage hits were FIXED, not excused: the 259-char provenance block (.demo-note) and the map legend's swipe hint both dropped text-transform:uppercase.
exceptions.verified: Longest remaining all-caps run is 47 chars.

fixed_not_excused: wide-tracking 0.06em removed from .shelf-note (prose, not a label); resized 11.5px -> 13.5px sans

contrast: raw foil stops run 3.43-3.69:1 as text on the #2D2D2D panel and fail AA, so a parallel text ramp (--s1t..--s5t, 4.9-9.3:1) was introduced for anything set in type. The raw ramp is now used only for gradients, strokes and artwork.
two form <label hidden> elements replaced with aria-label (display:none labels have no accessible name)
